evidence.title: CommonSpan consolidation note
evidence.detail: CommonSpan Holdings Ltd. (ORG-268) consolidates Aster Power Assemblies Ltd. and Boreal Power Systems Ltd. as controlled subsidiaries. Separate brands do not imply separate ultimate ownership. This is an ownership statement, not a statement that CommonSpan manufactures or supplies components.

evidence.title: Jade corporate structure
evidence.detail: Jade Circuits Holdings Ltd. (ORG-445) is the accounting parent of Jade Printed Circuits Ltd. (ORG-453). The operating plant is SITE-081 in Z01; SITE-901 in Z07 is the registered headquarters and does not manufacture circuit substrates.

evidence.title: IonPeak capacity and qualification statement
evidence.detail: IonPeak Semiconductor Ltd. manufactures the NovaDrive-relevant production power dies at SITE-074 in East Delta (Z01). SITE-900 in Western Ridge is a research and pilot facility using a different process. It is not a qualified replacement for these dies. Ion Peak Trading Ltd., registry REG-NO-4128, is an unrelated broker, not a subsidiary of IonPeak Semiconductor.

evidence.title: Current power-die sourcing note
evidence.detail: The current M10/M20 programs at both Aster and Boreal use the same qualified IonPeak production die family from SITE-074. No second die source is currently qualified for these programs. A different module assembler therefore does not provide independent die supply. PolarSwitch is a prospective alternative only.

evidence.title: Current circuit-substrate sourcing note
evidence.detail: Cobalt C10 programs and Grove/HarborSense B10 programs currently use Jade substrates from SITE-081. The listed substrate is program-specific. There is no presently qualified independent substrate in the supplied corpus; this is not a claim about all of these companies' products.

evidence.title: Archived Delta supplier award
evidence.detail: Delta Capacitor Works supplied housings to NovaDrive under a pilot program in 2022. That housing program ended on 31 December 2023. The current capacitor award is separate. Do not treat the expired housing award as a current H10 supply connection.

evidence.title: Harbor Freight role clarification
evidence.detail: Harbor Freight Services acts as a consolidator or notify party on a number of shipping manifests. It does not manufacture the listed electronics. OceanLink Ports operates a terminal; neither name should automatically be classified as a component manufacturer.

evidence.title: Supplier launch correction
evidence.detail: A 2024 memorandum between Delta Consumer Plastics and NovaDrive concerned trial retail packaging, not production electronics. The trial did not convert to a supply award. Similarity of the word Delta does not connect this company to Delta Capacitor Works.

evidence.title: Solace program clarification
evidence.detail: Solace Optics has completed a sample evaluation with Grove Battery Controls. No serial-production award has been announced. The supplied evidence does not substantiate a current B10 production link. A team may retain this as a hypothesis, but should not assert a confirmed supply relationship.

evidence.title: Quartz raw-material sourcing note
evidence.detail: Quartz Alloy confirms integrated alloy processing but does not identify bauxite sources. Its membership of a minerals association is not a supplier declaration. Direct upstream sourcing remains unverified.

events.title: East Delta flood watch
events.detail: The East Delta authority issues a flood watch for Z01. No factory damage or shutdown is confirmed.

events.title: Trade-wire repeats flood watch
events.detail: This article republishes the same East Delta authority bulletin as EV-001. It adds no independent evidence.

events.title: Meridian financing pressure
events.detail: Meridian Dielectrics reports covenant negotiations and delayed payments to two trade creditors; production continues.

events.title: Ion Peak Trading insolvency filing
events.detail: Ion Peak Trading Ltd., REG-NO-4128, enters restructuring. The company is a broker in Harbor District, not IonPeak Semiconductor.

events.title: Archived port strike reposted
events.detail: An aggregator republishes a port strike from 3 November 2023. The original dispute ended in 2023. No current strike is announced.

events.title: Jade head office relocation
events.detail: Jade moves its administrative headquarters within Harbor District. Production remains at its East Delta site.

events.title: Delta packaging allegation corrected
events.detail: An allegation concerns Delta Consumer Plastics, not Delta Capacitor Works. No named link to NovaDrive production is established.

events.title: Gulf Arc port congestion
events.detail: OceanLink reports average terminal delay of three days for Gulf Arc departures. Shipment-specific impact has not been assessed.
